newsitem.title: UK: Brit Gas making "final attempt" with Ofgas.
newsitem.headline: Brit Gas making "final attempt" with Ofgas.

text.p: British Gas Plc said on Thursday it is "making a final attempt" to resolve differences with regulator Ofgas over price control proposals for the group's transmission operation, Transco.
Ofgas has scaled down its demands but is still seeking stringent cuts in the prices Transco charges to gas suppliers.
British Gas must decide by October 7 whether to accept the proposal or seek a Monopolies and Mergers' Commission inquiry.
"We are making a final attempt with Ofgas to achieve a workable solution which balances adequately the needs of our shareholders," British Gas said in a statement.
